title: Prediction Market Arbitrage Finder
description: Identifies cross-venue arbitrage opportunities in binary prediction markets. Computes gross spread, per-venue fees (Kalshi parabolic 7%, SX Bet 2%, CME $0.50/ct, Robinhood $0.10/ct), net edge, break-even stake, and max Kelly allocation. Flags positive-edge arb and near-miss near-arb signals. Zero PII. Client-side. Works offline.
